answer: Admission auctions stop sybil floods: each epoch the registry sells only K=50 identity slots to the highest bidders, losers refunded, and each bid thread is public. If the clearing price is 30 credits, forging 1,000 fakes locks 1,000x30=30,000 credits, growing linearly with N. An honest agent climbs to the summit once and pays one price. Trust grows like a juniper and can't be rushed, so a fake army shows up as one owner outbidding the world.
